description: Tier-4 reference game (D-056, CONTENT §12) on the generated dev archipelago of seed 1053001 from the content starting stock only: bootstrap_merchants step for step (all but its final wait, to minute 320), then the same attentive play (producer counts from the houses' demand with 10 % headroom, whole-minute waits, nearest sites a road reaches, no pauses, demolitions or stock grants). At home 50 Merchant houses with one alternative per Merchant category (sausages, beer, coats, books) and the Citizen and Settler houses to staff them, four more districts (a market and a chapel each), warehouses where a collector runs over 95 %, and the church; route 1 brings hops and stone, sloop 2 founds island 6 (quartz, copper, grapes, hemp) with planks from island 2 and ships its hemp to a sailmaker at home until a third sloop takes over, then returns to its bricks route. Patricians unlock at minute 663. On island 6 a quartz quarry, two glass smelters, a copper mine and smelter (brass), a thread spinner and three vineyards, shipped home by sloop 3 and a brig; on island 2 pig farms, salt pans, dairy and cattle farms beyond the home ones, shipped home by a galleon; at home a slaughterhouse (roast beef), a cooperage and a winepress (wine), a lace maker, an optician (spectacles) and a luthier (instruments), and four Patrician houses. The first Patrician house stands at minute 762 and every Patrician category reaches 0.6 by 798 (targets 900 / 960 / 1800).
name: bootstrap_patricians
